result_text:
In `DataExporter.exportJson` (`reports/.../dataexporters/DataExporter.java`), `all_files.zip` no longer uses the five hard-coded file names. For each scope aspect (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) it now takes the name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same call that writes the loose `aspect_*.txt` files, and the loop reads each file back under that name. The zip entry carries the same name, in the same order.

With the default configuration the entries are unchanged. With `buildAndDeploymentt` renamed to `buildAndDeployment`, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. Because the read no longer throws, `git-history.zip` is written as well when `git-history.txt` exists.

The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or a real export, so the renamed-aspect case itself isn't checked.
